objective: Prospective transfer only, using 12 previously unused origins after the old TRAIN/DEV audio-guitar/gallery-piano/low-margin cell delivered average net +.30 / +.15454545 at price .30. Source-clip qualification and human inspection are disclosed. No fitting or source relabeling on the 48 evaluations. No future-outcome access by the decision head.
source_unit: 12 production groups, 4 windows each, equal source weights. 6 piano/6 guitar. All 48 analyzed once; no replacements after source seal.
primary: Three matched original BP seeds. Within each recording average utility across its four windows, then average its three original seeds. Two paired QVI minus fixed and QVI minus ordinary learned source contrasts. Certified superiority requires mean >=.03 on EACH, worst QVI source relative to free >=-.05 and one-sided exact sign tests passing Holm familywise .05 (ties abs<=1e-12); report all differences and counts. Practical cutoff is a research criterion of this new transfer study.
adaptation: bp (profiled outer BP plus analytical head)
secondary: Report both controls and all 18 old read-enabled heads incl actual per-source utility, accuracy, waits and reads. Repeat paired comparisons with SVD descriptively. First-prefix comparators are old full-svd-.1, its old DEV-selected LP and projected-gradient edits, and the previously sealed 6-coordinate TRAIN-only edit. Do not score the jointly constructed TRAIN/DEV capacity witness as a competitor. For the four immediate selective comparators apply original adoption rules vs always-free and always-paid separately, with no study-wide winner selected. Report one-group old audio/guitar gallery-disagreement net opportunity descriptively. No refits or new representation.
waiting: At the frozen cost report a hindsight upper bound for allowing 6 prefixes over the best first-prefix choice; per-source mean gain >=.015 in at least two sources with positive gain and global mean >=.015 is not used as primary superiority criterion. Report actual wait timing/action counts.
timing: Record actual packing/feature decoding, old-weights inference, scoring and verification time separately. No fresh training was incurred. Previously published training and edit wall times are from their own studies; equal-quality full training-time comparisons require an adopted contender.
recording_scope: Source and named credits/uploader are checked against 44 prior selected works. Unknown performer/device identity and original upstream pretraining exposure cannot be universally certified. This two-class recording task does not measure cross-modal retrieval R@1.
